purpose: Choose a public opponent-behaviour inference rule before opening held-out test labels. This is not focal-policy adoption or strength qualification.
selection: Minimum exported validation macro negative log-likelihood over all 60 player-count/rule/phase groups. Candidates within 1e-10 of that minimum are numerically tied; retain the first in fixed order. No per-count, per-rule or per-phase routing and no fitted ensemble weights or temperatures.
ensemble: Equal arithmetic mean of the four members' masked categorical probabilities, computed in float64 log space. Each member uses its independently verified best validation checkpoint. Single members use original exported logits; every policy chooses the first maximum in original legal-index order.
baseline: Twice the existing public economic-prior action feature 74 on the same public shortlist. If it wins selection, report no learned validation improvement and do not open the test split.
validation_scope: All validation rows from deals 24..27, all seats/rules/counts, exactly as collected. Forced choices are reported separately. Keep every candidate and adverse group; validation metrics used for selection are not unbiased generalization estimates.
test_scope: Only after a learned policy is frozen, prepare every test record from whole deals 28..31, all 320 games. Evaluate that frozen policy and the economic prior; never reselect models, weights or routing from test outcomes. Report all 60 groups and exact-input overlap with training as a separate diagnostic, without discarding rows from the primary result.
interpretation: Agreement/NLL measure imitation of a sampled 16-rollout opponent, not optimal actions. Teacher-sample regret is diagnostic, not independent policy value. Held-out imitation alone cannot justify adding this model to deployed search.
required_afterwards: Fresh paired continuations against actual reference search
Fresh full-game strength across all player counts/rules/opponent families
Exact exported selected-runtime verification and actual AMD 8840U hybrid latency
